kernel: unresolved BAR/resource allocation for a required device fails the cycle
required endpoint/controller missing fails the cycle
fatal AER on the qualified path fails the cycle (correctable physical-layer messages are retained as observations; they do not fail the cycle unless final device state is broken)
IOMMU/DMAR fault invalidating device operation fails the cycle
amdgpu init/reset/hang failure affecting either die fails the cycle
manual recovery required fails the cycle
network: no manual driver reload or interface surgery
storage: root filesystem mounted from the expected device/source
usb: baseline USB host controller set remains enumerated (superset tolerated, disappearance fails)
optional input device: if present at baseline, same device identity remains enumerated
v340l: exactly one PM8533 fanout topology present with exactly two Vega 1002:6864 physical functions
final BARs assigned, non-overlapping, and every BAR has a real host bridge window
both functions expose expected device-local capacity (~8 GiB) and usable Vulkan devices
fresh selector->physical-device binding unique (2 distinct selectors, 2 distinct BDFs)
root port + switch upstream retain Gen3 x1 (8.0 GT/s, width 1) campaign identity
no unresolved final PCI resource allocation failure

final_boot_full_check.mode: v2a_harness canonical execution via accepted authority semantics
final_boot_full_check.requirement: die A and die B each pass one canonical execution with byte-exact visible output and clean accounting; #210 evidence is never reinterpreted or overwritten

errors: journalctl -b: AER/fatal/nonfatal PCIe, amdgpu init/reset/fault, DMAR/IOMMU faults, IRQ conflicts, NIC/USB/storage init errors, PCI BAR allocation failures/retries
pci: root port -> PM8533 -> Vega endpoint path
LnkCap/LnkSta on endpoint, switch upstream, root port
peripherals: USB host controllers + root hubs + attached input devices (lsusb)
storage controller/root fs mount + non-destructive read/write sentinel

argv: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Explain what happens next in one sentence:
sentinel.offload_requirement: full offload (-ngl 99) with zero fallback; offloaded layers must equal the accepted per-die full-offload count observed at qualification
sentinel.reference_provenance: accepted V1-A frozen visible greedy output (reused byte-identically by accepted V2-B)
sentinel.selector_resolution: fresh per-boot discovery; never reuse a previous boot's selector authority

sequence.cold_rule: the cold cycle is a real power-off -> power-on only if operator power action is recorded in the cycle artifact; otherwise the campaign ends warm-only

cycles.note: pre-reboot baseline snapshot; not counted as a boot transition
additional (4th) warm reboot satisfying the >=1 extra warm/firmware requirement
full cold power cycle executed by the operator on signal; never counted as warm

sequence.denominator_rule: every requested transition that reaches evaluation is retained, pass or fail; a failed cycle is never omitted from the denominator
